summary: The study evaluates the thermal stability of TiB2 metal gate on Hf silicate for p-channel metal oxide semiconductor applications using atomic layer deposition. The work function of TiB2 gate was found to be around 5.08 eV, and it remained stable up to 1000 °C annealing. However, at 1100 °C, work function lowering was observed due to metal-dielectric intermixing and oxygen vacancy formation.
evidence: HfSiOx films were directly deposited on p-type substrates with a resistivity of 3 – 25 cm by atomic layer deposition at 300 °C. The oxidizing agents for TEMAH and Si were O3 and H2O, respectively. The work function lowering at 1100 °C was caused by metal-dielectric intermixing and oxygen vacancy formation.
